title: The Resurrection of the Wicked
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The resurrection of the wicked is the future raising of those outside Christ for judgment. Scripture teaches that unbelief and unrepentant sin will not escape God’s final righteous judgment.
summary: The resurrection of the wicked is the future raising of those outside Christ for judgment. Scripture teaches that unbelief and unrepentant sin will not escape God’s final righteous judgment.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the appointed Judge as well as the Savior. His authority over resurrection includes the raising of the wicked to judgment and the giving of life to those who believe.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that there will be a resurrection of both the just and the unjust. Death does not erase guilt, silence God’s justice, or end accountability.

The resurrection of the wicked is not resurrection unto glory, but unto judgment. Those who remain outside Christ will stand before God and face His righteous verdict.

This doctrine should be handled soberly. It is not given for pride, harshness, or speculation, but as a warning that sin and unbelief carry eternal consequences.

Christ’s role as Judge magnifies the urgency of His role as Savior. The same Lord who warns of judgment also calls sinners to come to Him for life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often assume that death ends responsibility or that God will simply overlook evil. Scripture teaches otherwise. Every person will be raised and judged according to truth.

This doctrine gives urgency to evangelism and repentance. It is loving to warn people that there is judgment after death and to point them to Christ who saves.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Take God’s warnings seriously. Do not speak of judgment carelessly or avoid it out of fear of offense. Let the resurrection of the wicked move you to repentance, prayer, compassion, and faithful Gospel witness.
